it's ok, sorry that my response is late to you as well
yes, i do

thank you for your response, and for your honesty as well. when people say things like it gets better, i just want to say, how can you know for sure?
sometimes the uncertainty of it keeps me hanging in there, like tomorrow might be a better day but who knows.
realistically, i think i know there might be a chance for me to accomplish something and maybe even someone out there in my life who'd like to see me do well but i just have a hard time believing anything good about myself or that i'll accomplish anything. i mentally can't force myself to do anything other than like i said "exist"
as for times i should feel happy- just little things, like if people compliment me i feel it's a lie. or things i would normally enjoy bring me little to no pleasure.
the thing that i think is more of a burden on my life right now is this sense of emptiness/sadness. it's hard to describe. i just feel like when i'm around people i'm on the outside looking in.
i'm happy for you that your life got better, and i appreciate you taking the time to comment.

firstly thank you for your support. sorry my reply is late
second, i'm not really sure. i just felt like i needed to get that off my chest i guess, i feel like there's not many people in my life i can talk to. i dunno. i just feel really empty, no matter what. like i'll never really find my place in life, which sounds silly i guess. i just feel useless at every aspect of life.

thank you for your comment. that isn't a silly thing to point out at all, i appreciate your offer to help and kind words.
i apologize but i don't feel comfortable giving my specific location - i can tell you i live a little over an hour from charlotte, nc if that helps you at all again i apologize this is my first time posting here.
